resources.string: Please wait. Adapter connection may take a while....

Connection to the device has been established.\n Start collecting data from ECU.
Error occurred during connection.\nPlease check your network settings.
Network connection might be turned off.\n Please check your settings.

The Bluetooth LE adapter did not respond. Pairing alone is not enough: a dual-mode adapter does not broadcast while paired over Bluetooth Classic.
Open the system Bluetooth settings, CONNECT the adapter there, then try again.
Adapter is not selected. Please select Adapter and try again.
To communicate with your vehicle, please allow Bluetooth access.
To access WIFI network, record your trip route and speed, please allow Location access.

To provide full functionality, please allow the following in the next steps:

• Battery Optimization: To ensure data logging isn\'t interrupted.
• Location: To track your trip via GPS.
• Bluetooth: To connect to your OBD adapter.
• Notifications: To keep the logger running in the background.
